Messages.Author: badger
Messages.Body:
Dear LSJ:

In regard to the Unique Master Card - The Damned:
Can this card be used as an offensive weapon in the following sense -
play on a vampire of your prey. Next turn play on a second vampire of
your prey. Are those vampires now contesting that card, such that my
prey would have to pay 2 pool to contest? How would such a scenario
work? (including playing on a different Methuselah's vampire).

Thanks,

Badger

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <357497B9...@buffnet.net>,


The Damned is a Master card, as such it remains controlled by you regardless
of whom it is placed on.

If you play another one, again reagrdless of the target, you will contest
it with yourself.

--
